paper_threshold.extra_rule: direction of week-8 log2FC must agree between males and females

final.deviation_note: paper: 5% IHW-FDR on Fisher-combined per-sex LRT p plus sex sign agreement at week 8; applied: BH padj < 0.05 on the pooled Wald W8 vs SED test, no fold-change rule (the paper has none). Sign agreement is computed afterwards in HANDBACK as a supplementary count.

threshold.reasoning: S5.4.3.p2: ERGs at 5% IHW FDR, no fold-change cutoff.

caveats: paper ERGs are LRT-based (any training time point) with Fisher/IHW; ours are Wald week-8 vs control with BH, so counts are not expected to match exactly

executions.name: pooled
executions.reasoning: One DESeq2 fit on all 50 animals of the tissue (5 groups x 5 M + 5 F), ~ sex + grp. grp_W8_vs_SED is the paper's 8-week EET vs control estimand (S2.7.p1; S5.4.3.p2 week-8 log2FC); W1/W2/W4 vs SED come from the same fit and are exploratory (the paper's LRT used all groups).
